model.note: The model page lists image and video input. This protocol uses text only.

routeLock.reason: Two endpoints share the same display name and provider but have different tags, prices and tier thresholds. The approved rule keeps Gate E open when routes cannot be told apart by the decision the user must make. The tag distinguishes them, but the choice between them is the user's and has not been made.
routeLock.fallbackPolicy: must be disabled in the locked request (allow_fallbacks false, order or only set to the chosen tag); not yet set
routeLock.requiredBeforeLicense: user chooses one tag; the request will name that provider and disable fallback

budgetImplications.priceTierRule: The override applies at min_prompt_tokens. The metadata does not state whether the tier is chosen per request on prompt size. The planning rule charges a request at the highest tier its UTF-8 byte count reaches, which is conservative because tokens <= bytes.
budgetImplications.maxTierReachedByInternalBudget: the 32000 tier only; the 256000 tier is unreachable under the byte cap

gatesStillOpen: user choice of route tag, then locked provider request (gate E)
